situation-room.delete-prompt-one: Deleting {name} removes its roster, assignments and invite links for {n} observer. Their reports stay in the public record and still count.\n\nType the room name to confirm:
situation-room.disclosure: What this can and cannot see. Every figure here comes from the same public feed as the rest of Hawkeye — this room gets no early access, no unpublished numbers, and no sight of any other group’s observers. It shows which of the already-public reports came from your people, and only from the moment they joined: their earlier reports are not yours to see.
situation-room.doubled-many: {n} units have more than one observer down for it.
situation-room.doubled-note: One unit covered twice usually means another unit is not covered at all. They are marked ▲ below — use {change} to move someone, if you see fit.
situation-room.doubled-one: {n} unit has more than one observer down for it.
situation-room.incidents-note: This is the public list. Every incident here is already on Hawkeye for anyone to read — nothing is shown before it is published, and no other group’s observers are named. What this tab adds is which ones came from your people. Weighing a claim happens in the public docket, not here.
situation-room.invite-deliberate: Joining is always a deliberate tap — a link forwarded into a group chat never enrols whoever opens it.
situation-room.invite-share: Share your invite link however you already talk to your people. Anyone who taps it, signs in and joins appears here.
situation-room.my-area-vs-race: The whole {race} race is at {pct}, so you are {delta}.
situation-room.no-reports-from-your-obse: No reports from your observers yet.
situation-room.nothing-has-been-publishe: Nothing has been published for this race. Incidents appear once they clear review, at the same moment the public sees them.
situation-room.nothing-your-own-people-f: Nothing your own people filed has been published in this race yet.
situation-room.only-the-owner-can-delete: Only the owner can delete this room.
situation-room.only-used-to-put-your-emb: Only used to put your emblem on your own console.
situation-room.only-where-our-observers-: Only where our observers are silent
situation-room.pick-the-area-they-will-c: Pick the area they will cover.
situation-room.pick-the-race-this-room-i: Pick the race this room is watching.
situation-room.remove-this-manager-they-: Remove this manager? They keep their place on the roster as an observer.
situation-room.revoke-this-link-anyone-w: Revoke this link? Anyone who has not used it yet will not be able to join with it.
situation-room.select-a-row-to-open-the-: Select a row to open the places inside it.
situation-room.setup-intro: Watch a race and your own observers on one screen: which units have reported, where your coverage is thin, and who has yet to file.
situation-room.setup-roster: Your observers report the way everyone else does — the group is a roster, never a gate. Nothing here changes what they can send or when.
situation-room.that-did-not-match-the-na: That did not match the name. Nothing was deleted.
